newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina plans pet food plant in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina plans pet food plant in Argentina.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co. said Thursday it will build a multimillion dollar pet food plant in Santo Tome, Argentina, to meet an increase in demand for pet food in Latin America.

The plant is expected to be in operation in late 1997 and will produce a full line of Purina dry dog and cat food products. The Santo Tome plant will serve customers in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay and southern Brazil.
Purina pet food volumes rose 23 percent in Latin America and the Caribbean in fiscal 1996, according to Ralston Purina.
Ralston Purina's pet products division is the world's largest producer of dry dog and dry and moist cat foods.
Ralston's shares were down 25 cents at $73 a share in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
